notes.title: Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey Release
notes.notes: [p]Hello.[/p][p][/p][p]We're happy to announce that Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey releases today. To celebrate this occasion the game will be available at a discounted price. Additionally, our other title will also be on sale during this time.[/p][p][/p][p]With the release of the game the screenshots were updated and a new trailer presenting the game was released. Some of our previous trailers were removed but they will still be available on our Youtube channel.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo version of the game was also updated to the final release version.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your interest.[/p]

notes.title: Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]Hello.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey's[/i] release date has been set to 21.07.2025. A few updates have been made to the description of the game and also a few screenshots have been added to show a few different tracks that the racing will take place on.[/p][p]
Thank you for your interest.[/p]

notes.title: Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

The demo of Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey will be available on the Steam page for everyone who would want to try the game. In the demo two game modes are available - single race and single tournament at one of the two available tracks.

With the release of the demo new screenshots and new video trailer were also added to the game's page.

Thanks for checking it out.

notes.title: Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey - graphics update
notes.notes:
Hello.

A little update on the graphical side of the game - new screenshots were added and old ones were removed. Screenshots presenting career screens were added.
In Career mode rankings are randomly generated at the start of each new career.

Thank you for your interest.

notes.title: Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey - Gameplay teaser
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

A new video has been added to Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey. It presents a teaser of a few races in form of a music video.
In addition - game's screenshots were updated and game's planned release date has been set to Q3 2025.

Thank you for your interest.
